note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown in the original, so only the soldier and worker are treated; the synonymy list, figure numbers, locality and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule and labrum yellowish brown, antennae pale yellow, darker apically, mandibles dark reddish brown, head and body sparsely hairy, total length 3.8–4.10 mm. Head capsule oval, narrowed anteriorly, slightly longer than wide; mandibles slender, sickle-shaped, slightly longer than half head length. Workers dimorphic, major worker total length 3.20–3.35 mm with antennae 17-segmented, minor worker distinctly smaller. No alate described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Total length 3.8–4.10. Head capsule oval, narrowed anteriorly, length to base of mandibles 1.0–1.15, maximum width 0.89–0.98. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segments 3 and 5 subequal in length. Labrum lingulate, anterior margin broad and rounded. Mandibles slender, sickle-shaped, apex very weakly incurved, 0.63–0.78 long, slightly longer than half head length, mandible length/head length 0.58–0.70. Left mandible with one sharp, laterally directed tooth at the apical third, tooth distance 0.22–0.27, tooth distance/mandible length 0.32–0.34; right mandible with one small tooth slightly above the middle. Postmentum subrectangular, 0.58–0.68 long, 0.40–0.45 maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin deeply concave, posterior margin distinctly incurved at middle, 0.39–0.45 long, 0.65–0.69 wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule, labrum and thorax light yellowish brown, antennae light brown, body and legs pale creamy yellow; head sparsely hairy, body moderately hairy; total length 3.20–3.35. Head capsule subquadrate, length to base of mandibles 0.90–1.10, maximum width 0.98–1.21. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal and shortest. Postclypeus raised, with a few short hairs, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin nearly straight, 0.30–0.38 long, 0.60–0.65 wide. Minor worker: similar to major worker but smaller, total length 2.5, length to base of mandibles 0.63, maximum head width 0.71, pronotum width 0.43.
